title: Marathon 1
description: Sustained throughput under concurrency — medium-length generations executed at concurrency 1, 4, and 16. Measures aggregate throughput, tail latency under load, and scaling efficiency.

reference.label: synthetic-1
reference.notes: v1 anchors the 1000-point scale to round-number synthetic baselines (100 tok/s aggregate at c=1, 800 tok/s at c=16, 8000ms p99 at c=16, CV 0.15) rather than a measured reference rig. A future suite version will re-anchor to measured hardware; per the versioning rules that resets the leaderboard.

tasks.prompt: Explain how photosynthesis works in detail, covering both the light-dependent reactions and the Calvin cycle, including where each stage occurs in the chloroplast and what the inputs and outputs are. Write roughly 400 words.
Write a detailed comparison of SQL and NoSQL databases: data models, schema flexibility, consistency guarantees, scaling strategies, and typical use cases for each. Write roughly 400 words.

Describe the Earth's water cycle in detail, covering evaporation, transpiration, condensation, precipitation, infiltration, and runoff, and explain how energy from the sun drives the cycle. Write roughly 400 words.

Explain the causes and consequences of the 2008 global financial crisis, covering subprime mortgages, securitization, the collapse of major institutions, and the policy responses that followed. Write roughly 400 words.
